company.name: Fitze UAE
company.shortDescription: Fitze UAE is a fitness incentives software that tracks physical activity and offers digital incentives through wellness challenges.
company.description: Fitze is a UAE-based fitness and wellness platform that combines activity tracking with reward-based engagement. The company operates a mobile application that converts users’ daily steps into digital coins redeemable for discounts, offers, and promotional rewards from partner brands. The platform also organizes fitness challenges, jackpot campaigns, and corporate wellness programs aimed at encouraging healthier lifestyles and employee engagement
